finalText:
Fixed. The root cause was in `packages/shared/config.js` — `resolveRelease` merged the defaults, per-package overrides, and CLI flags with `Object.assign`, which is a shallow merge. Any package overriding just one key inside `output` (e.g. `@acme/api` setting `output.format`, `@acme/web`/`@acme/cli` setting `output.entry`) wiped out the rest of the nested `output` object — dropping `output.dir`, which the bundle stage requires and aborted the build.

I replaced it with a recursive `deepMerge` that merges nested plain objects layer by layer instead of overwriting them wholesale. `node build.js` now exits 0 with "5 warnings, 0 errors", and `verify.js` confirms the fix.
